entries.sanskrit:
द्वादशे तु पुराणोक्त-सर्वार्थानुक्रमः कृतः ।

प्रथम-स्कन्धम् आरभ्य प्राधान्येन समासतः ॥

तद् एवम् अस्मिन् पुराणे विस्तरेणोक्तान् अर्थान् सङ्क्षेपतो वर्णयिष्यन् धर्मादीन् प्रणमति, नम इति। महते हरि-भक्ति-लक्षणाय। ब्राह्मणेभ्यो ब्राह्मणान्। सनातनान् अनादीन्। धर्मान् इत्य् उपलक्षणं पुराणोक्तार्थानाम् ॥१॥
entries.main_sanskrit:
सूत उवाच—

नमो धर्माय महते नमः कृष्णाय वेधसे ।  
ब्रह्मणेभ्यो नमस्कृत्य धर्मान् वक्ष्ये सनातनान् ॥
entries.transliteration:
sūta uvāca—

namo dharmāya mahate namaḥ kṛṣṇāya vedhase |
brahmaṇebhyo namaskṛtya dharmān vakṣye sanātanān ||
entries.literal_english: Sūta Gosvāmī said: Offering my obeisances to the supreme religious principle, devotional service; to Lord Kṛṣṇa, the supreme creator; and to all the brāhmaṇas, I shall now describe the eternal principles of religion.
entries.source_note: Pinned source: vishvAsa/purANam_vaiShNavam @ 100560de6c9f68c2875097d40a2012a84c784179; exact source range preserved.

entries.sanskrit: पुरुषत्वे उचितं श्रवणादि-योग्यम् ॥२॥
entries.main_sanskrit:
एतद् वः कथितं विप्रा विष्णोश् चरितम् अद्भुतम् ।  
भवद्भिर् यद् अहं पृष्टो नराणां पुरुषोचितम् ॥
entries.transliteration:
etad vaḥ kathitaṃ viprā viṣṇoś caritam adbhutam |
bhavadbhir yad ahaṃ pṛṣṭo narāṇāṃ puruṣocitam ||
entries.literal_english: O great sages, I have narrated to you the wonderful pastimes of Lord Viṣṇu, as you inquired about them from me. Hearing such narrations is the suitable engagement for a person who is actually a human being.
entries.source_note: Pinned source: vishvAsa/purANam_vaiShNavam @ 100560de6c9f68c2875097d40a2012a84c784179; exact source range preserved.

entries.sanskrit: एतत् प्रपञ्चयति—अत्रेति । भगवान् ऐश्वर्यादि-षड्-गुणः । साक्षात् सङ्कीर्तित इति देवता-काण्डार्थः ॥३॥
entries.main_sanskrit:
अत्र सङ्कीर्तितः साक्षात् सर्व-पाप-हरो हरिः ।  
नारायणो हृषीकेशो भगवान् सात्वतां पतिः ॥
entries.transliteration:
atra saṅkīrtitaḥ sākṣāt sarva-pāpa-haro hariḥ |
nārāyaṇo hṛṣīkeśo bhagavān sātvatāṃ patiḥ ||
word_for_word: the Personality of Godhead, Lord Hari
entries.literal_english: This literature fully glorifies the Supreme Personality of Godhead Hari, who removes all His devotees’ sinful reactions. The Lord is glorified as Nārāyaṇa, Hṛṣīkeśa and the Lord of the Sātvatas.
entries.source_note: Pinned source: vishvAsa/purANam_vaiShNavam @ 100560de6c9f68c2875097d40a2012a84c784179; exact source range preserved.

entries.sanskrit: ब्रह्म-काण्डार्थम् आह—अत्र ब्रह्मेति । गुह्यं निर्गुणम् । प्रभवाप्ययम्, प्रभवत्य् अस्माद् इति प्रभवम्, अप्येत्य् अस्मिन्न् इत्य् अप्ययम्, तच् च तच् च । अनेनाश्रय-शब्दार्थो दर्शितः । विज्ञान-संयुतम् अपरोक्ष-ज्ञान-पर्यन्तं ज्ञानम् । तद्-उपाख्यानं तज्-ज्ञानम् उपाख्यायते प्रकाश्यते येन तज्-ज्ञान-साधनम् इत्य् अर्थः ॥४॥
entries.main_sanskrit:
अत्र ब्रह्म परं गुह्यं जगतः प्रभवाप्ययम् ।  
ज्ञानं च तद्-उपाख्यानं प्रोक्तं विज्ञान-संयुतम् ॥
entries.transliteration:
atra brahma paraṃ guhyaṃ jagataḥ prabhavāpyayam |
jñānaṃ ca tad-upākhyānaṃ proktaṃ vijñāna-saṃyutam ||
entries.literal_english: This literature describes the mystery of the Supreme Absolute Truth, the source of the creation and annihilation of this universe. Also presented are divine knowledge of Him together with the process of its cultivation, and the transcendental realization one achieves.
entries.source_note: Pinned source: vishvAsa/purANam_vaiShNavam @ 100560de6c9f68c2875097d40a2012a84c784179; exact source range preserved.

entries.sanskrit: कर्म-काण्डार्थम् आह, भक्ति-योगश् च साध्य-साधन-रूपः । तद्-आश्रयं भक्ति-योगेन निष्पादितम् । एवं सामान्यतो निरूप्येदानीं द्वादश-स्कन्ध-प्रकरणार्थान् अनुक्रामति । पारीक्षितम् उपाख्यानं परीक्षिज्-जन्मादि, तत्-प्रस्तावाय नारदाख्यानं च ॥५॥
entries.main_sanskrit:
भक्ति-योगः समाख्यातो वैराग्यं च तद्-आश्रयम् ।  
पारीक्षितम् उपाख्यानं नारदाख्यानम् एव च ॥
entries.transliteration:
bhakti-yogaḥ samākhyāto vairāgyaṃ ca tad-āśrayam |
pārīkṣitam upākhyānaṃ nāradākhyānam eva ca ||
entries.literal_english: The following topics are also narrated: the process of devotional service together with its subsidiary feature of renunciation, and the histories of Mahārāja Parīkṣit and the sage Nārada. Also described are saintly King Parīkṣit’s sitting down to fast until death in response to the curse of a brāhmaṇa’s son, and the conversations between Parīkṣit and Śukadeva Gosvāmī, who is the best of all brāhmaṇas
entries.source_note: Pinned source: vishvAsa/purANam_vaiShNavam @ 100560de6c9f68c2875097d40a2012a84c784179; exact source range preserved.

entries.sanskrit: ब्रह्म-र्षभस्य ब्राह्मणोत्तमस्य । इति प्रथम-स्कन्धार्थः ॥६॥
entries.main_sanskrit:
प्रायोपवेशो राजर्षेर् विप्र-शापात् परीक्षितः ।  
शुकस्य ब्रह्मर्षभस्य संवादश् च परीक्षितः ॥
entries.transliteration:
prāyopaveśo rājarṣer vipra-śāpāt parīkṣitaḥ |
śukasya brahmarṣabhasya saṃvādaś ca parīkṣitaḥ ||
entries.literal_english: Also described are saintly King Parīkṣit’s sitting down to fast until death in response to the curse of a brāhmaṇa’s son, and the conversations between Parīkṣit and Śukadeva Gosvāmī, who is the best of all brāhmaṇas.
entries.source_note: Pinned source: vishvAsa/purANam_vaiShNavam @ 100560de6c9f68c2875097d40a2012a84c784179; exact source range preserved.

entries.sanskrit: उत्क्रान्तिर् अर्चिर् आदि-गतिः । प्राधणिकः प्रधान-कार्य-विराड्-रूपः सर्गः । अग्रत आदितो महद्-आदि-क्रमेणेत्य् अर्थः । इति द्वितीयार्थः ॥७॥
entries.main_sanskrit:
योग-धारणयोत्क्रान्तिः संवादो नारदाजयोः ।  
अवतारानुगीतं च सर्गः प्राधानिकोऽग्रतः ॥
entries.transliteration:
yoga-dhāraṇayotkrāntiḥ saṃvādo nāradājayoḥ |
avatārānugītaṃ ca sargaḥ prādhāniko’grataḥ ||
entries.literal_english: The Bhāgavatam explains how one can attain liberation at the time of death by practicing fixed meditation in yoga. It also contains a discussion between Nārada and Brahmā, an enumeration of the incarnations of the Supreme Personality of Godhead, and a description of how the universe was created in progressive sequence, beginning from the unmanifest stage of material nature.
entries.source_note: Pinned source: vishvAsa/purANam_vaiShNavam @ 100560de6c9f68c2875097d40a2012a84c784179; exact source range preserved.

entries.sanskrit: महा-पुरुषस्य संस्थितिः प्रलये तूष्णीम् अवस्थानम् ॥८॥
entries.main_sanskrit:
विदुरोद्धव-संवादः क्षत्तृ-मैत्रेययोस् ततः ।  
पुराण-संहिता-प्रश्नो महा-पुरुष-संस्थितिः ॥
entries.transliteration:
viduroddhava-saṃvādaḥ kṣattṛ-maitreyayos tataḥ |
purāṇa-saṃhitā-praśno mahā-puruṣa-saṃsthitiḥ ||
word_for_word: This scripture also relates the discussions Vidura had with Uddhava and with Maitreya, inquiries about the subject matter of this Purāṇa, and the winding up of creation within the body of the Supreme Lord at the time of annihilation.
entries.literal_english: This scripture also relates the discussions Vidura had with Uddhava and with Maitreya, inquiries about the subject matter of this Purāṇa, and the winding up of creation within the body of the Supreme Lord at the time of annihilation.
entries.source_note: Pinned source: vishvAsa/purANam_vaiShNavam @ 100560de6c9f68c2875097d40a2012a84c784179; exact source range preserved.

entries.sanskrit: प्राकृतिकः प्रकृति-भवो गुण-क्षोभ-रूपः । वैकृतिका महद्-आदयश् च-काराद् विकाराश् च ये तेषां सर्गः ॥९॥
entries.main_sanskrit:
ततः प्राकृतिकः सर्गः सप्त-वैकृतिकाश् च ये ।  
ततो ब्रह्माण्ड-सम्भूतिर् वैराजः पुरुषो यतः ॥
entries.transliteration:
tataḥ prākṛtikaḥ sargaḥ sapta-vaikṛtikāś ca ye |
tato brahmāṇḍa-sambhūtir vairājaḥ puruṣo yataḥ ||
entries.literal_english: The creation effected by the agitation of the modes of material nature, the seven stages of evolution by elemental transformation, and the construction of the universal egg, from which arises the universal form of the Supreme Lord — all these are thoroughly described.
entries.source_note: Pinned source: vishvAsa/purANam_vaiShNavam @ 100560de6c9f68c2875097d40a2012a84c784179; exact source range preserved.

entries.sanskrit: गतिः स्वरूपम् । उद्धरणे उद्धारणे ॥१०॥
entries.main_sanskrit:
कालस्य स्थूल-सूक्ष्मस्य गतिः पद्म-समुद्भवः ।  
भुव उद्धरणेऽम्भोधेर् हिरण्याक्ष-वधो यथा ॥
entries.transliteration:
kālasya sthūla-sūkṣmasya gatiḥ padma-samudbhavaḥ |
bhuva uddharaṇe’mbhodher hiraṇyākṣa-vadho yathā ||
entries.literal_english: Other topics include the subtle and gross movements of time, the generation of the lotus from the navel of Garbhodakaśāyī Viṣṇu, and the killing of the demon Hiraṇyākṣa when the earth was delivered from the Garbhodaka Ocean.
entries.source_note: Pinned source: vishvAsa/purANam_vaiShNavam @ 100560de6c9f68c2875097d40a2012a84c784179; exact source range preserved.

entries.sanskrit: अर्धाभ्यां नारी च नरश् च तस्य सर्गः ॥११॥
entries.main_sanskrit:
ऊर्ध्व-तिर्यग्-अवाक्-सर्गो रुद्र-सर्गस् तथैव च ।  
अर्ध-नारीश्वरस्याथ यतः स्वायम्भुवो मनुः ॥
entries.transliteration:
ūrdhva-tiryag-avāk-sargo rudra-sargas tathaiva ca |
ardha-nārīśvarasyātha yataḥ svāyambhuvo manuḥ ||
entries.literal_english: The Bhāgavatam also describes the creation of demigods, animals and demoniac species of life; the birth of Lord Rudra; and the appearance of Svāyambhuva Manu from the half-man, half-woman Īśvara.
entries.source_note: Pinned source: vishvAsa/purANam_vaiShNavam @ 100560de6c9f68c2875097d40a2012a84c784179; exact source range preserved.

entries.sanskrit: सन्तानो धर्म-पत्नीनाम् इति नव-ब्रह्म-समुत्पत्तिर् इत्य् अस्यानन्तरं द्रष्टव्यम् ॥१२॥
entries.main_sanskrit:
शतरूपा च या स्त्रीणाम् आद्या प्रकृतिर् उत्तमा ।  
सन्तानो धर्म-पत्नीनां कर्दमस्य प्रजापतेः ॥
entries.transliteration:
śatarūpā ca yā strīṇām ādyā prakṛtir uttamā |
santāno dharma-patnīnāṃ kardamasya prajāpateḥ ||
entries.literal_english: Also related are the appearance of the first woman, Śatarūpā, who was the excellent consort of Manu, and the offspring of the pious wives of Prajāpati Kardama.
entries.source_note: Pinned source: vishvAsa/purANam_vaiShNavam @ 100560de6c9f68c2875097d40a2012a84c784179; exact source range preserved.

entries.sanskrit: न व्याख्यातम्।
entries.main_sanskrit:
अवतारो भगवतः कपिलस्य महात्मनः ।
देवहूत्याश् च संवादः कपिलेन च धी-मता ॥
entries.transliteration:
avatāro bhagavataḥ kapilasya mahātmanaḥ |
devahūtyāś ca saṃvādaḥ kapilena ca dhī-matā ||
entries.literal_english: No commentary.
entries.source_note: Pinned source: vishvAsa/purANam_vaiShNavam @ 100560de6c9f68c2875097d40a2012a84c784179; exact source range preserved; no commentary is present for this range.

entries.sanskrit: इति तृतीयार्थः । चतुर्थ-स्कन्धार्थम् आह—नव-ब्रह्मणां मरीच्य्-आदीनां समुत्पत्तिः सन्तानः ॥१४॥
entries.main_sanskrit:
नव-ब्रह्म-समुत्पत्तिर् दक्ष-यज्ञ-विनाशनम् ।  
ध्रुवस्य चरितं पश्चात् पृथोः प्राचीनबर्हिषः ॥
entries.transliteration:
nava-brahma-samutpattir dakṣa-yajña-vināśanam |
dhruvasya caritaṃ paścāt pṛthoḥ prācīnabarhiṣaḥ ||
entries.literal_english: Also described are the progeny of the nine great brāhmaṇas, the destruction of Dakṣa’s sacrifice, and the history of Dhruva Mahārāja, followed by the histories of King Pṛthu and King Prācīnabarhi, the discussion between Prācīnabarhi and Nārada, and the life of Mahārāja Priyavrata. Then, O brāhmaṇas, the Bhāgavatam tells of the character and activities of King Nābhi, Lord Ṛṣabha and King Bharata.
entries.source_note: Pinned source: vishvAsa/purANam_vaiShNavam @ 100560de6c9f68c2875097d40a2012a84c784179; exact source range preserved.

entries.sanskrit: पञ्चम-स्कन्धार्थम् आह—ततः प्रैयव्रतं प्रियव्रतस्य चरितम् ॥१५॥
entries.main_sanskrit:
नारदस्य च संवादस् ततः प्रैयव्रतं द्विजाः ।  
नाभेस् ततोऽनुचरितम् ऋषभस्य भरतस्य च ॥
entries.transliteration:
nāradasya ca saṃvādas tataḥ praiyavrataṃ dvijāḥ |
nābhes tato’nucaritam ṛṣabhasya bharatasya ca ||
entries.literal_english: Also described are the progeny of the nine great brāhmaṇas, the destruction of Dakṣa’s sacrifice, and the history of Dhruva Mahārāja, followed by the histories of King Pṛthu and King Prācīnabarhi, the discussion between Prācīnabarhi and Nārada, and the life of Mahārāja Priyavrata. Then, O brāhmaṇas, the Bhāgavatam tells of the character and activities of King Nābhi, Lord Ṛṣabha and King Bharata.
entries.source_note: Pinned source: vishvAsa/purANam_vaiShNavam @ 100560de6c9f68c2875097d40a2012a84c784179; exact source range preserved.

entries.sanskrit: द्वीपाद्य्-उपवर्णनं प्रथमं सङ्क्षेपतस् ततो द्वीपादीनां ये गिरयो नद्यश् च तेषाम् उपवर्णनम् । पातालानां नरकाणां च संस्थितिः । अनेनैव नरक-निवर्तकम् अजामिलोपाख्यानं गृहीतं ततः पराचीनम् ॥१६॥
entries.main_sanskrit:
द्वीप-वर्ष-समुद्राणां गिरि-नद्य्-उपवर्णनम् ।  
ज्योतिश्-चक्रस्य संस्थानं पाताल-नरक-स्थितिः ॥
entries.transliteration:
dvīpa-varṣa-samudrāṇāṃ giri-nady-upavarṇanam |
jyotiś-cakrasya saṃsthānaṃ pātāla-naraka-sthitiḥ ||
word_for_word: The Bhāgavatam gives an elaborate description of the earth’s continents, regions, oceans, mountains and rivers. Also described are the arrangement of the celestial sphere and the conditions found in the subterranean regions and in hell.
entries.literal_english: The Bhāgavatam gives an elaborate description of the earth’s continents, regions, oceans, mountains and rivers. Also described are the arrangement of the celestial sphere and the conditions found in the subterranean regions and in hell.
entries.source_note: Pinned source: vishvAsa/purANam_vaiShNavam @ 100560de6c9f68c2875097d40a2012a84c784179; exact source range preserved.

entries.sanskrit: षष्ठार्थम् आह—दक्ष-जन्मेति ॥७॥
entries.main_sanskrit:
दक्ष-जन्म प्रचेतोभ्यस् तत्-पुत्रीणां च सन्ततिः ।  
यतो देवासुर-नरास् तिर्यङ्-नग-खगादयः ॥
entries.transliteration:
dakṣa-janma pracetobhyas tat-putrīṇāṃ ca santatiḥ |
yato devāsura-narās tiryaṅ-naga-khagādayaḥ ||
entries.literal_english: The rebirth of Prajāpati Dakṣa as the son of the Pracetās, and the progeny of Dakṣa’s daughters, who initiated the races of demigods, demons, human beings, animals, serpents, birds and so on — all this is described.
entries.source_note: Pinned source: vishvAsa/purANam_vaiShNavam @ 100560de6c9f68c2875097d40a2012a84c784179; exact source range preserved.

entries.sanskrit: सप्तमार्थम् आह—पुत्रयोश् चेति ॥१८॥
entries.main_sanskrit:
त्वाष्ट्रस्य जन्म-निधनं पुत्रयोश् च दितेर् द्विजाः ।  
दैत्येश्वरस्य चरितं प्रह्रादस्य महात्मनः ॥
entries.transliteration:
tvāṣṭrasya janma-nidhanaṃ putrayoś ca diter dvijāḥ |
daityeśvarasya caritaṃ prahrādasya mahātmanaḥ ||
entries.literal_english: O brāhmaṇas, also recounted are the births and deaths of Vṛtrāsura and of Diti’s sons Hiraṇyākṣa and Hiraṇyakaśipu, as well as the history of the greatest of Diti’s descendants, the exalted soul Prahlāda.

entries.sanskrit: अष्टमार्थम् आह—मन्वन्तरानुकथनम् इति । क्वचित् कस्याचिद् अनुक्तिर् व्युत्क्रमोक्तिश् च भक्ति-रसाकुलत्वेनेति द्रष्टव्यम् ॥१९॥
entries.main_sanskrit:
मन्व्-अन्तरानुकथनं गजेन्द्रस्य विमोक्षणम् ।  
मन्व्-अन्तरावताराश् च विष्णोर् हयशिरादयः ॥
entries.transliteration:
manv-antarānukathanaṃ gajendrasya vimokṣaṇam |
manv-antarāvatārāś ca viṣṇor hayaśirādayaḥ ||
entries.literal_english: The reign of each Manu, the liberation of Gajendra, and the special incarnations of Lord Viṣṇu in each manvantara, such as Lord Hayaśīrṣā, are described as well.
entries.source_note: Pinned source: vishvAsa/purANam_vaiShNavam @ 100560de6c9f68c2875097d40a2012a84c784179; exact source range preserved.

entries.sanskrit: न व्याख्यातम्।
entries.main_sanskrit:
कौर्मं मात्स्यं नारसिंहं वामनं च जगत्-पतेः ।  
क्षीरोद-मथनं तद्वद् अमृतार्थे दिवौकसाम् ॥
entries.transliteration:
kaurmaṃ mātsyaṃ nārasiṃhaṃ vāmanaṃ ca jagat-pateḥ |
kṣīroda-mathanaṃ tadvad amṛtārthe divaukasām ||

entries.sanskrit: नवमार्थम् आह—राज-वंशेति ॥२१॥
entries.main_sanskrit:
देवासुर-महा-युद्धं राज-वंशानुकीर्तनम् ।  
इक्ष्वाकु-जन्म तद्-वंशः सुद्युम्नस्य महात्मनः ॥
entries.transliteration:
devāsura-mahā-yuddhaṃ rāja-vaṃśānukīrtanam |
ikṣvāku-janma tad-vaṃśaḥ sudyumnasya mahātmanaḥ ||
word_for_word: देवासुर-महा-युद्धं राज-वंशानुकीर्तनम् ।   इक्ष्वाकु-जन्म तद्-वंशः सुद्युम्नस्य महात्मनः ॥

An account of the great battle fought between the demigods and the demons, a systematic description of the dynasties of various kings, and narrations concerning Ikṣvāku’s birth, his dynasty and the dynasty of the pious Sudyumna — all are presented within this literature.

entries.sanskrit: न व्याख्यातम्।
entries.main_sanskrit:
इलोपाख्यानम् अत्रोक्तं तारोपाख्यानम् एव च ।  
सूर्य-वंशानुकथनं शशादाद्या नृगादयः ॥

सौकन्यं चाथ शर्यातेः ककुत्स्थस्य च धीमतः ।  
खट्वाङ्गस्य च मान्धातुः सौभरेः सगरस्य च ॥

रामस्य कोशलेन्द्रस्य चरितं किल्बिषापहम् ।  
निमेर् अङ्ग-परित्यागो जनकानां च सम्भवः ॥
entries.transliteration:
ilopākhyānam atroktaṃ tāropākhyānam eva ca |
sūrya-vaṃśānukathanaṃ śaśādādyā nṛgādayaḥ ||

saukanyaṃ cātha śaryāteḥ kakutsthasya ca dhīmataḥ |
khaṭvāṅgasya ca māndhātuḥ saubhareḥ sagarasya ca ||

rāmasya kośalendrasya caritaṃ kilbiṣāpaham |
nimer aṅga-parityāgo janakānāṃ ca sambhavaḥ ||

entries.sanskrit: सोम-वंशादि-भूतस्यैलस्य चरितम् ॥२५॥
entries.main_sanskrit:
रामस्य भार्गवेन्द्रस्य निःक्षत्री-करणं भुवः ।  
ऐलस्य सोम-वंशस्य ययातेर् नहुषस्य च ॥
entries.transliteration:
rāmasya bhārgavendrasya niḥkṣatrī-karaṇaṃ bhuvaḥ |
ailasya soma-vaṃśasya yayāter nahuṣasya ca ||
entries.literal_english: The Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam describes how Lord Paraśurāma, the greatest descendant of Bhṛgu, annihilated all the kṣatriyas on the face of the earth. It further recounts the lives of glorious kings who appeared in the dynasty of the moon-god — kings such as Aila, Yayāti, Nahuṣa, Duṣmanta’s son Bharata, Śāntanu and Śāntanu’s son Bhīṣma. Also described is the great dynasty founded by King Yadu, the eldest son of Yayāti.

entries.sanskrit: तत्-सुतस्य भीष्मस्य ॥२६॥
entries.main_sanskrit:
दौष्मन्तेर् भरतस्यापि शान्तनोस् तत्-सुतस्य च ।  
ययातेर् ज्येष्ठ-पुत्रस्य यदोर् वंशोऽनुकीर्तितः ॥
entries.transliteration:
dauṣmanter bharatasyāpi śāntanos tat-sutasya ca |
yayāter jyeṣṭha-putrasya yador vaṃśo’nukīrtitaḥ ||

It further recounts the lives of glorious kings who appeared in the dynasty of the moon-god — kings such as Aila, Yayāti, Nahuṣa, Duṣmanta’s son Bharata, Śāntanu and Śāntanu’s son Bhīṣma. Also described is the great dynasty founded by King Yadu, the eldest son of Yayāti.

entries.main_sanskrit:
यत्रावतीर्णो भगवान् कृष्णाख्यो जगद्-ईश्वरः ।  
वसुदेव-गृहे जन्म ततो वृद्धिश् च गोकुले ॥
entries.transliteration:
yatrāvatīrṇo bhagavān kṛṣṇākhyo jagad-īśvaraḥ |
vasudeva-gṛhe janma tato vṛddhiś ca gokule ||

entries.sanskrit: दशमार्थम् आह—तस्य कर्माणीति । पूतनाया असु-सहितस्य स्तन्य-पयसः पानम् ॥२८॥
entries.main_sanskrit:
तस्य कर्माण्य् अपाराणि कीर्तितान्य् असुर-द्विषः ।  
पूतनासु-पयः-पानं शकटोच्चाटनं शिशोः ॥
entries.transliteration:
tasya karmāṇy apārāṇi kīrtitāny asura-dviṣaḥ |
pūtanāsu-payaḥ-pānaṃ śakaṭoccāṭanaṃ śiśoḥ ||
entries.literal_english: Also glorified are the innumerable pastimes of Śrī Kṛṣṇa, the enemy of the demons, including His childhood pastimes of sucking out Pūtanā’s life air along with her breast milk, breaking the cart, trampling down Tṛṇāvarta, killing Bakāsura, Vatsāsura and Aghāsura, and the pastimes He enacted when Lord Brahmā hid His calves and cowherd boyfriends in a cave.

entries.main_sanskrit:
तृणावर्तस्य निष्पेषस् तथैव बक-वत्सयोः ।  
अघासुर-वधो धात्रा वत्स-पालावगूहनम्] ॥
entries.transliteration:
tṛṇāvartasya niṣpeṣas tathaiva baka-vatsayoḥ |
aghāsura-vadho dhātrā vatsa-pālāvagūhanam] ||

entries.sanskrit: सह-भ्रातुः स-सखस्य ॥३०॥
entries.main_sanskrit:
धेनुकस्य सह-भ्रातुः प्रलम्बस्य च सङ्क्षयः ।  
गोपानां च परित्राणं दावाग्नेः परिसर्पतः ॥
entries.transliteration:
dhenukasya saha-bhrātuḥ pralambasya ca saṅkṣayaḥ |
gopānāṃ ca paritrāṇaṃ dāvāgneḥ parisarpataḥ ||
entries.literal_english: The Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam tells how Lord Kṛṣṇa and Lord Balarāma killed the demon Dhenukāsura and his companions, how Lord Balarāma destroyed Pralambāsura, and also how Kṛṣṇa saved the cowherd boys from a raging forest fire that had encircled them.

entries.sanskrit: न व्याख्यातम्।
entries.main_sanskrit:
दमनं कालियस्याहेर् महाहेर् नन्द-मोक्षणम् ।  
व्रत-चर्या तु कन्यानां यत्र तुष्टोऽच्युतो व्रतैः ॥
entries.transliteration:
damanaṃ kāliyasyāher mahāher nanda-mokṣaṇam |
vrata-caryā tu kanyānāṃ yatra tuṣṭo’cyuto vrataiḥ ||
entries.literal_english: No commentary.
entries.source_note: Pinned source: vishvAsa/purANam_vaiShNavam @ 100560de6c9f68c2875097d40a2012a84c784179; exact source range preserved.

entries.sanskrit: न व्याख्यातम्।
entries.main_sanskrit:
प्रसादो यज्ञ-पत्नीभ्यो विप्राणां चानुतापनम् ।  
गोवर्धनोद्धारणं च शक्रस्य सुरभेर् अथ ॥

यज्ञाभिषेकः कृष्णस्य स्त्रीभिः क्रीडा च रात्रिषु ।  
शङ्खचूडस्य दुर्बुद्धेर् वधोऽरिष्टस्य केशिनः ॥
entries.transliteration:
prasādo yajña-patnībhyo viprāṇāṃ cānutāpanam |
govardhanoddhāraṇaṃ ca śakrasya surabher atha ||

yajñābhiṣekaḥ kṛṣṇasya strībhiḥ krīḍā ca rātriṣu |
śaṅkhacūḍasya durbuddher vadho’riṣṭasya keśinaḥ ||
entries.literal_english: No commentary.
entries.source_note: Pinned source: vishvAsa/purANam_vaiShNavam @ 100560de6c9f68c2875097d40a2012a84c784179; exact source range preserved.

entries.sanskrit: न व्याख्यातम्।
entries.main_sanskrit:
अक्रूरागमनं पश्चात् प्रस्थानं राम-कृष्णयोः ।  
व्रज-स्त्रीणां विलापश् च मथुरालोकनं ततः ॥

गज-मुष्टिक-चाणूर- कंसादीनां तथा वधः ।  
मृतस्यानयनं सूनोः पुनः सान्दीपनेर् गुरोः ॥

मथुरायां निवसता यदु-चक्रस्य यत् प्रियम् ।  
कृतम् उद्धव-रामाभ्यां युतेन हरिणा द्विजाः ॥
entries.transliteration:
akrūrāgamanaṃ paścāt prasthānaṃ rāma-kṛṣṇayoḥ |
vraja-strīṇāṃ vilāpaś ca mathurālokanaṃ tataḥ ||

gaja-muṣṭika-cāṇūra- kaṃsādīnāṃ tathā vadhaḥ |
mṛtasyānayanaṃ sūnoḥ punaḥ sāndīpaner guroḥ ||

mathurāyāṃ nivasatā yadu-cakrasya yat priyam |
kṛtam uddhava-rāmābhyāṃ yutena hariṇā dvijāḥ ||
entries.literal_english: No commentary.
entries.source_note: Pinned source: vishvAsa/purANam_vaiShNavam @ 100560de6c9f68c2875097d40a2012a84c784179; exact source range preserved.

entries.sanskrit: ये च शम्बरादयस् तेषां माहात्म्यं प्रभावो वधश् च ॥३९॥
entries.main_sanskrit:
जरासन्ध-समानीत- सैन्यस्य बहुशो वधः ।  
घातनं यवनेन्द्रस्य कुशस्थल्या निवेशनम् ॥

आदानं पारिजातस्य सुधर्मायाः सुरालयात् ।  
रुक्मिण्या हरणं युद्धे प्रमथ्य द्विषतो हरेः ॥

हरस्य जृम्भणं युद्धे बाणस्य भुज-कृन्तनम् ।  
प्राग्ज्योतिष-पतिं हत्वा कन्यानां हरणं च यत् ॥
entries.transliteration:
jarāsandha-samānīta- sainyasya bahuśo vadhaḥ |
ghātanaṃ yavanendrasya kuśasthalyā niveśanam ||

ādānaṃ pārijātasya sudharmāyāḥ surālayāt |
rukmiṇyā haraṇaṃ yuddhe pramathya dviṣato hareḥ ||

harasya jṛmbhaṇaṃ yuddhe bāṇasya bhuja-kṛntanam |
prāgjyotiṣa-patiṃ hatvā kanyānāṃ haraṇaṃ ca yat ||
entries.literal_english: Also described are the annihilation of each of the many armies brought by Jarāsandha, the killing of the barbarian king Kālayavana and the establishment of Dvārakā City. This work also describes how Lord Kṛṣṇa brought from heaven the pārijāta tree and the Sudharmā assembly hall, and how He kidnapped Rukmiṇī by defeating all His rivals in battle. Also narrated are how Lord Kṛṣṇa, in the battle with Bāṇāsura, defeated Lord Śiva by making him yawn, how the Lord cut off Bāṇāsura’s arms, and how He killed the master of Prāgjyotiṣapura and then rescued the young princesses held captive in that city.
entries.source_note: Pinned source: vishvAsa/purANam_vaiShNavam @ 100560de6c9f68c2875097d40a2012a84c784179; exact source range preserved.

entries.sanskrit: एकादशार्थम् आह—विप्र-शापेति ॥४०॥
entries.main_sanskrit:
चैद्य-पौण्ड्रक-शाल्वानां दन्तवक्रस्य दुर्मतेः ।  
शम्बरो द्विविदः पीठो मुरः पञ्चजनादयः ॥
entries.transliteration:
caidya-pauṇḍraka-śālvānāṃ dantavakrasya durmateḥ |
śambaro dvividaḥ pīṭho muraḥ pañcajanādayaḥ ||
entries.literal_english: There are descriptions of the powers and the deaths of the King of Cedi, Pauṇḍraka, Śālva, the foolish Dantavakra, Śambara, Dvivida, Pīṭha, Mura, Pañcajana and other demons, along with a description of how Vārāṇasī was burned to the ground. The Bhāgavatam also recounts how Lord Kṛṣṇa relieved the earth’s burden by engaging the Pāṇḍavas in the Battle of Kurukṣetra.
entries.source_note: Pinned source: vishvAsa/purANam_vaiShNavam @ 100560de6c9f68c2875097d40a2012a84c784179; exact source range preserved.

entries.sanskrit: न व्याख्यातम्।
entries.main_sanskrit:
माहात्म्यं च वधस् तेषां वाराणस्याश् च दाहनम् ।
भारावतरणं भूमेर् निमित्ती-कृत्य पाण्डवान् ॥
entries.transliteration:
māhātmyaṃ ca vadhas teṣāṃ vārāṇasyāś ca dāhanam |
bhārāvataraṇaṃ bhūmer nimittī-kṛtya pāṇḍavān ||
entries.literal_english: No commentary.

entries.sanskrit: धर्म-विनिर्णयो वर्णाश्रम-धर्म-विनिश्चयः । मर्त्य-परित्यागो मनुष्यत्वस्यान्तर्धानम् ॥४२॥
entries.main_sanskrit:
विप्र-शापापदेशेन संहारः स्व-कुलस्य च ।  
उद्धवस्य च संवादो वसुदेवस्य चाद्भुतः ॥
entries.transliteration:
vipra-śāpāpadeśena saṃhāraḥ sva-kulasya ca |
uddhavasya ca saṃvādo vasudevasya cādbhutaḥ ||
entries.literal_english: How the Lord withdrew His own dynasty on the pretext of the brāhmaṇas’ curse; Vasudeva’s conversation with Nārada; the extraordinary conversation between Uddhava and Kṛṣṇa, which reveals the science of the self in complete detail and elucidates the religious principles of human society; and then how Lord Kṛṣṇa gave up this mortal world by His own mystic power — the Bhāgavatam narrates all these events.
entries.source_note: Pinned source: vishvAsa/purANam_vaiShNavam @ 100560de6c9f68c2875097d40a2012a84c784179; exact source range preserved.

entries.sanskrit: द्वादशार्थम् आह—युगेति । युग-लक्षणं तद्-अनुरूपा वृत्तिश् चेत्य् अर्थः । त्रि-विध प्राकृतिकी नैमित्तिकी नित्या चेति ॥४३॥
entries.main_sanskrit:
यत्रात्म-विद्या ह्य् अखिला प्रोक्ता धर्म-विनिर्णयः ।  
ततो मर्त्य-परित्याग आत्म-योगानुभावतः ॥
entries.transliteration:
yatrātma-vidyā hy akhilā proktā dharma-vinirṇayaḥ |
tato martya-parityāga ātma-yogānubhāvataḥ ||
entries.literal_english: How the Lord withdrew His own dynasty on the pretext of the brāhmaṇas’ curse; Vasudeva’s conversation with Nārada; the extraordinary conversation between Uddhava and Kṛṣṇa, which reveals the science of the self in complete detail and elucidates the religious principles of human society; and then how Lord Kṛṣṇa gave up this mortal world by His own mystic power — the Bhāgavatam narrates all these events.
entries.source_note: Pinned source: vishvAsa/purANam_vaiShNavam @ 100560de6c9f68c2875097d40a2012a84c784179; exact source range preserved.

entries.sanskrit: ऋषेर् व्यासस्य । सूर्यस्य च विन्यास इत्य् अर्थः ॥४४॥
entries.main_sanskrit:
युग-लक्षण-वृत्तिश् च कलौ नॄणाम् उपप्लवः ।  
चतुर्-विधश् च प्रलय उत्पत्तिस् त्रि-विधा तथा ॥
entries.transliteration:
yuga-lakṣaṇa-vṛttiś ca kalau nṝṇām upaplavaḥ |
catur-vidhaś ca pralaya utpattis tri-vidhā tathā ||
word_for_word: in the present Age of Kali
entries.literal_english: This work also describes people’s characteristics and behavior in the different ages, the chaos men experience in the Age of Kali, the four kinds of annihilation and the three kinds of creation.
entries.source_note: Pinned source: vishvAsa/purANam_vaiShNavam @ 100560de6c9f68c2875097d40a2012a84c784179; exact source range preserved.

entries.sanskrit: इति चोक्तम् इति च-काराद् अन्यद् अपि वो युष्माभिर् इह यत् पृष्टोऽस्मि, तद् उक्तम् इति । किम् एवं नानार्थ-कथनेन ? तत्राह—लीलेति । सर्वशः तत्-तद्-अर्थ-कीर्तन-द्वारेणेत्य् अर्थः ॥४५॥
entries.main_sanskrit:
देह-त्यागश् च राजर्षेर् विष्णु-रातस्य धीमतः ।

शाखा-प्रणयनम् ऋषेर् मार्कण्डेयस्य सत्-कथा ।  
महा-पुरुष-विन्यासः सूर्यस्य जगद्-आत्मनः ॥
entries.transliteration:
deha-tyāgaś ca rājarṣer viṣṇu-rātasya dhīmataḥ |

śākhā-praṇayanam ṛṣer mārkaṇḍeyasya sat-kathā |
mahā-puruṣa-vinyāsaḥ sūryasya jagad-ātmanaḥ ||
entries.literal_english: There are also an account of the passing away of the wise and saintly King Viṣṇurāta \[Parīkṣit\], an explanation of how Śrīla Vyāsadeva disseminated the branches of the Vedas, a pious narration concerning Mārkaṇḍeya Ṛṣi, and a description of the detailed arrangement of the Lord’s universal form and His form as the sun, the soul of the universe.
entries.source_note: Pinned source: vishvAsa/purANam_vaiShNavam @ 100560de6c9f68c2875097d40a2012a84c784179; exact source range preserved.

entries.sanskrit: तत्-कीर्तनेनापि किम् ? इत्य् अपेक्षायां तत्-फलम् आह द्वाभ्याम् ॥४६॥
entries.main_sanskrit:
इति चोक्तं द्विज-श्रेष्ठा यत् पृष्टोऽहम् इहास्मि वः ।  
लीलावतार-कर्माणि कीर्तितानीह सर्वशः ॥
entries.transliteration:
iti coktaṃ dvija-śreṣṭhā yat pṛṣṭo’ham ihāsmi vaḥ |
līlāvatāra-karmāṇi kīrtitānīha sarvaśaḥ ||
entries.literal_english: Thus, O best of the brāhmaṇas*,* I have explained herein what you have inquired from me. This literature has glorified in full detail the activities of the Lord’s pastime incarnations.
entries.source_note: Pinned source: vishvAsa/purANam_vaiShNavam @ 100560de6c9f68c2875097d40a2012a84c784179; exact source range preserved.

entries.main_sanskrit:
पतितः स्खलितश् चार्तः क्षुत्त्वा वा विवशो गृणन् ।  
हरये नम इत्य् उच्चैर् मुच्यते सर्व-पातकात् ॥
entries.transliteration:
patitaḥ skhalitaś cārtaḥ kṣuttvā vā vivaśo gṛṇan |
haraye nama ity uccair mucyate sarva-pātakāt ||
entries.literal_english: No commentary.

entries.sanskrit: न व्याख्यातम्।
entries.main_sanskrit:
सङ्कीर्त्यमानो भगवान् अनन्तः

श्रुतानुभावो व्यसनं हि पुंसाम् ।

प्रविश्य चित्तं विधुनोत्य् अशेषं

यथा तमोऽर्कोऽभ्रम् इवातिवातः ॥
entries.transliteration:
saṅkīrtyamāno bhagavān anantaḥ

śrutānubhāvo vyasanaṃ hi puṃsām |

praviśya cittaṃ vidhunoty aśeṣaṃ

yathā tamo’rko’bhram ivātivātaḥ ||
entries.literal_english: No commentary.
entries.source_note: Pinned source: vishvAsa/purANam_vaiShNavam @ 100560de6c9f68c2875097d40a2012a84c784179; exact source range preserved.

entries.sanskrit: हरि-सङ्कीर्तनम् एव महा-फलं तद्-व्यतिरिक्तं सर्वं मिथ्यालाप-मात्रम् इति प्रपञ्चयति—मृषा-गिर इति चतुर्भिः । मृषा-गिरो मिथ्या-वाचः । असतीर् असत्यः । असतां कथा यासु ताः । यद् यासु उत्तम-श्लोकस्य यशोऽनुगीयत इति यत् तद् एव सत्यं तद् एव हि मङ्गलम् । उ ह इति हर्षे । भगवद्-गुणानाम् अभ्युदयो यस्मात् तत् ॥४९॥
entries.main_sanskrit:
मृषा गिरस् ता ह्य् असतीर् असत्-कथा

न कथ्यते यद् भगवान् अधोक्षजः ।

तद् एव सत्यं तद् उ हैव मङ्गलं

तद् एव पुण्यं भगवद्-गुणोदयम् ॥
entries.transliteration:
mṛṣā giras tā hy asatīr asat-kathā

na kathyate yad bhagavān adhokṣajaḥ |

tad eva satyaṃ tad u haiva maṅgalaṃ

tad eva puṇyaṃ bhagavad-guṇodayam ||
entries.literal_english: Words that do not describe the transcendental Personality of Godhead but instead deal with temporary matters are simply false and useless. Only those words that manifest the transcendental qualities of the Supreme Lord are actually truthful, auspicious and pious.
entries.source_note: Pinned source: vishvAsa/purANam_vaiShNavam @ 100560de6c9f68c2875097d40a2012a84c784179; exact source range preserved.

entries.sanskrit: नवं नवं यथा भवति, तथा रुचिरं रुचि-प्रदम् । महान् उत्सवो यस्मात् ॥५०॥
entries.main_sanskrit:
तद् एव रम्यं रुचिरं नवं नवं

तद् एव शश्वन् मनसो महोत्सवम् ।

तद् एव शोकार्णव-शोषणं नृणां

यद् उत्तमःश्लोक-यशोऽनुगीयते ॥
entries.transliteration:
tad eva ramyaṃ ruciraṃ navaṃ navaṃ

tad eva śaśvan manaso mahotsavam |

tad eva śokārṇava-śoṣaṇaṃ nṛṇāṃ

yad uttamaḥśloka-yaśo’nugīyate ||
entries.literal_english: Those words describing the glories of the all-famous Personality of Godhead are attractive, relishable and ever fresh. Indeed, such words are a perpetual festival for the mind, and they dry up the ocean of misery.
entries.source_note: Pinned source: vishvAsa/purANam_vaiShNavam @ 100560de6c9f68c2875097d40a2012a84c784179; exact source range preserved.

entries.sanskrit: चित्राणि पदानि यस्मिन्, तद् अपि जगत् पवित्रयतीति तथा तद् धरेर् यशो न प्रगृणीत न वर्णयेत् तद् वचो ध्वाङ्क्ष-तीर्थं काक-तुल्य-नराणं रति-स्थानं न तु हंसैर् ज्ञानिभिः सेवितम् । तत्र हेतुः—यत्रेति ॥५१॥
entries.main_sanskrit:
न यद् वचश् चित्र-पदं हरेर् यशो

जगत् पवित्रं प्रगृणीत कर्हिचित् ।

तद् ध्वाङ्क्ष-तीर्थं न तु हंस-सेवितं

यत्राच्युतस् तत्र हि साधवोऽमलाः ॥
entries.transliteration:
na yad vacaś citra-padaṃ harer yaśo

jagat pavitraṃ pragṛṇīta karhicit |

tad dhvāṅkṣa-tīrthaṃ na tu haṃsa-sevitaṃ

yatrācyutas tatra hi sādhavo’malāḥ ||
entries.literal_english: Those words that do not describe the glories of the Lord, who alone can sanctify the atmosphere of the whole universe, are considered to be like unto a place of pilgrimage for crows, and are never resorted to by those situated in transcendental knowledge. The pure and saintly devotees take interest only in topics glorifying the infallible Supreme Lord.
entries.source_note: Pinned source: vishvAsa/purANam_vaiShNavam @ 100560de6c9f68c2875097d40a2012a84c784179; exact source range preserved.

entries.sanskrit: न व्याख्यातम्।
entries.main_sanskrit:
स वाग्-विसर्गो जनताघ-सम्प्लवो

:
     तद्


यस्मिन् प्रति-श्लोकम् अबद्धवत्य् अपि ।

नामान्य् अनन्तस्य यशोऽङ्कितानि यत्

शृण्वन्ति गायन्ति गृणन्ति साधवः ॥
entries.transliteration:
sa vāg-visargo janatāgha-samplavo

:
     tad

yasmin prati-ślokam abaddhavaty api |

nāmāny anantasya yaśo’ṅkitāni yat

śṛṇvanti gāyanti gṛṇanti sādhavaḥ ||
entries.literal_english: No commentary.
entries.source_note: Pinned source: vishvAsa/purANam_vaiShNavam @ 100560de6c9f68c2875097d40a2012a84c784179; exact source range preserved.

entries.sanskrit: इदानीं ज्ञान-कर्मादराद् अपि भगवत्-कीर्तनादिष्व् एवादरः कर्तव्य इत्य् आह—नैष्कर्म्यं ब्रह्म, तत्-प्रकाशकं यज् ज्ञानं, यतो निरञ्जनम् उपाधि-निवर्तकं, तद् अपि अच्युत-भक्ति-वर्जितं चेन् न शोभते नापरोक्ष-पर्यन्तं भवतीत्य् अर्थः ॥५३॥
entries.main_sanskrit:
नैष्कर्म्यम् अप्य् अच्युत-भाव-वर्जितं

न शोभते ज्ञानम् अलं निरञ्जनम् ।

कुतः पुनः शश्वद् अभद्रम् ईश्वरे

न ह्य् अर्पितं कर्म यद् अप्य् अनुत्तमम् ॥
entries.transliteration:
naiṣkarmyam apy acyuta-bhāva-varjitaṃ

na śobhate jñānam alaṃ nirañjanam |

kutaḥ punaḥ śaśvad abhadram īśvare

na hy arpitaṃ karma yad apy anuttamam ||
word_for_word: self-realization, being freed from the reactions of fruitive work
entries.literal_english: Knowledge of self-realization, even though free from all material affinity, does not look well if devoid of a conception of the Infallible \[God\]. What, then, is the use of even the most properly performed fruitive activities, which are naturally painful from the very beginning and transient by nature, if they are not utilized for the devotional service of the Lord?
entries.source_note: Pinned source: vishvAsa/purANam_vaiShNavam @ 100560de6c9f68c2875097d40a2012a84c784179; exact source range preserved.

entries.sanskrit: किं च, वर्णश्रमाचारादिषु यः परो महान् परिश्रमः, स यशो-युक्तायां श्रियाम् एव । कीर्तिः संपत्तिश् च केवलं परः पुरुषार्थ इत्य् अर्थः । गुणानुवादादिभिस् तु श्रीधर-पाद-पद्मयोर् अविस्मृतिर् भवति ॥५४॥
entries.main_sanskrit:
यशः-श्रियाम् एव परिश्रमः परो

वर्णाश्रमाचार-तपः-श्रुतादिषु ।

अविस्मृतिः श्रीधर-पाद-पद्मयोर्

गुणानुवाद-श्रवणादरादिभिः ॥
entries.transliteration:
yaśaḥ-śriyām eva pariśramaḥ paro

varṇāśramācāra-tapaḥ-śrutādiṣu |

avismṛtiḥ śrīdhara-pāda-padmayor

guṇānuvāda-śravaṇādarādibhiḥ ||
entries.literal_english: The great endeavor one undergoes in executing the ordinary social and religious duties of the varṇāśrama system, in performing austerities, and in hearing from the Vedas culminates only in the achievement of mundane fame and opulence. But by respecting and attentively hearing the recitation of the transcendental qualities of the Supreme Lord, the husband of the goddess of fortune, one can remember His lotus feet.
entries.source_note: Pinned source: vishvAsa/purANam_vaiShNavam @ 100560de6c9f68c2875097d40a2012a84c784179; exact source range preserved.

entries.sanskrit: ततः किम् अत आह—अविस्मृतिर् इति । क्षिणोति नाशयति ॥५५॥
entries.main_sanskrit:
अविस्मृतिः कृष्ण-पदारविन्दयोः

क्षिणोत्य् अभद्राणि च शं तनोति ।

सत्त्वस्य शुद्धिं परमात्म-भक्तिं

ज्ञानं च विज्ञान-विराग-युक्तम् ॥
entries.transliteration:
avismṛtiḥ kṛṣṇa-padāravindayoḥ

kṣiṇoty abhadrāṇi ca śaṃ tanoti |

sattvasya śuddhiṃ paramātma-bhaktiṃ

jñānaṃ ca vijñāna-virāga-yuktam ||
entries.literal_english: Remembrance of Lord Kṛṣṇa’s lotus feet destroys everything inauspicious and awards the greatest good fortune. It purifies the heart and bestows devotion for the Supreme Soul, along with knowledge enriched with realization and renunciation.
entries.source_note: Pinned source: vishvAsa/purANam_vaiShNavam @ 100560de6c9f68c2875097d40a2012a84c784179; exact source range preserved.

entries.sanskrit: अथेदानीं श्रोतॄनात्मानं चाभिनन्दन्न् आह—यूयम् इति द्वाभ्याम् । हे द्विजाग्र्याः, यद् यस्माद् आत्मन्य् अन्तः-करणे श्री-नारायणम् आविवेश्य शश्वद् भजत । संभावनायां लोट् । अतो भूरि-भागा बहु-पुण्याः । कथं-भूतम् ? अखिलात्म-भूतं सर्वान्तर्यामिणम्, अत एव देवं सर्वोपास्यम् । अदेवं न देवोऽन्यो यस्य तम् । कुतः ? ईशम् । यद् वा, यस्माद् यूयं भूरि-भागास् तप-आदि-संपन्नास् ततो नारायणं भजतेति विधिः ॥५६॥
entries.main_sanskrit:
यूयं द्विजाग्र्या बत भूरि-भागा

यच् छश्वद् आत्मन्य् अखिलात्म-भूतम् ।

नारायणं देवम् अदेवम् ईशम्

अजस्र-भावा भजताविवेश्य ॥
entries.transliteration:
yūyaṃ dvijāgryā bata bhūri-bhāgā

yac chaśvad ātmany akhilātma-bhūtam |

nārāyaṇaṃ devam adevam īśam

ajasra-bhāvā bhajatāviveśya ||
word_for_word: beyond whom there is no other god
entries.literal_english: O most eminent of brāhmaṇas, you are all indeed extremely fortunate, since you have already placed within your hearts Lord Śrī Nārāyaṇa — the Personality of Godhead, the supreme controller and the ultimate Soul of all existence — beyond whom there is no other god. You have undeviating love for Him, and thus I request you to worship Him.
entries.source_note: Pinned source: vishvAsa/purANam_vaiShNavam @ 100560de6c9f68c2875097d40a2012a84c784179; exact source range preserved.

entries.sanskrit: मे मया श्रुतम् ॥५७॥
entries.main_sanskrit:
अहं च संस्मारित आत्म-तत्त्वं

श्रुतं पुरा मे परमर्षि-वक्त्रात् ।

प्रायोपवेशे नृपतेः परीक्षितः

सदस्य् ऋषीणां महतां च शृण्वताम् ॥
entries.transliteration:
ahaṃ ca saṃsmārita ātma-tattvaṃ

śrutaṃ purā me paramarṣi-vaktrāt |

prāyopaveśe nṛpateḥ parīkṣitaḥ

sadasy ṛṣīṇāṃ mahatāṃ ca śṛṇvatām ||
entries.literal_english: I also have now been fully reminded of the science of God, which I previously heard from the mouth of the great sage Śukadeva Gosvāmī. I was present in the assembly of great sages who heard him speak to King Parīkṣit as the monarch sat fasting until death.
entries.source_note: Pinned source: vishvAsa/purANam_vaiShNavam @ 100560de6c9f68c2875097d40a2012a84c784179; exact source range preserved.

entries.sanskrit: एवम् इत्य् आत्मानम् एव पुनातीति किं वक्तव्यम् ? काक्वा सर्वम् एव पुनातीत्य् अर्थः । एतत्-पुराण-कीर्तनादि-फलं प्रपञ्चयितुम् आह—एतद् इत्य् अष्टभिः ॥५८॥
entries.main_sanskrit:
एतद् वः कथितं विप्राः कथनीयोरु-कर्मणः ।  
माहात्म्यं वासुदेवस्य सर्वाशुभ-विनाशनम् ॥
entries.transliteration:
etad vaḥ kathitaṃ viprāḥ kathanīyoru-karmaṇaḥ |
māhātmyaṃ vāsudevasya sarvāśubha-vināśanam ||
entries.literal_english: O brāhmaṇas, I have thus described to you the glories of the Supreme Lord Vāsudeva, whose extraordinary activities are most worthy of glorification. This narration destroys all that is inauspicious.
entries.source_note: Pinned source: vishvAsa/purANam_vaiShNavam @ 100560de6c9f68c2875097d40a2012a84c784179; exact source range preserved.

entries.sanskrit: याम-क्षणं यामं क्षणं चेत्य् अर्थः । आत्मानम् एव साक्षात् पुनाति, न तु स्नानादि-वद् देह-मात्रम् ॥५९॥
entries.main_sanskrit:
य एतत् श्रावयेन् नित्यं याम-क्षणम् अनन्य-धीः ।

श्लोकम् एकं तद्-अर्धं वा पादं पादार्धम् एव वा ।  
श्रद्धावान् योऽनुशृणुयात् पुनात्य् आत्मानम् एव सः ॥
entries.transliteration:
ya etat śrāvayen nityaṃ yāma-kṣaṇam ananya-dhīḥ |

ślokam ekaṃ tad-ardhaṃ vā pādaṃ pādārdham eva vā |
śraddhāvān yo’nuśṛṇuyāt punāty ātmānam eva saḥ ||
entries.literal_english: One who with undeviating attention constantly recites this literature at every moment of every hour, as well as one who faithfully hears even one verse or half a verse or a single line or even half a line, certainly purifies his very self.
entries.source_note: Pinned source: vishvAsa/purANam_vaiShNavam @ 100560de6c9f68c2875097d40a2012a84c784179; exact source range preserved.

entries.sanskrit: न व्याख्यातम्।
entries.main_sanskrit:
द्वादश्याम् एकादश्यां वा शृण्वन्न् आयुष्यवान् भवेत् ॥

पठत्य् अनश्नन् प्रयतः पूतो भवति पातकात् ।
entries.transliteration:
dvādaśyām ekādaśyāṃ vā śṛṇvann āyuṣyavān bhavet ||

paṭhaty anaśnan prayataḥ pūto bhavati pātakāt |
entries.literal_english: No commentary.

entries.sanskrit: न व्याख्यातम्।
entries.main_sanskrit:
पुष्करे मथुरायां च द्वारवत्यां यतात्मवान् ।  
उपोष्य संहिताम् एतां पठित्वा मुच्यते भयात् ॥

देवता मुनयः सिद्धाः पितरो मनवो नृपाः ।  
यच्छन्ति कामान् गृणतः शृण्वतो यस्य कीर्तनात् ॥
entries.transliteration:
puṣkare mathurāyāṃ ca dvāravatyāṃ yatātmavān |
upoṣya saṃhitām etāṃ paṭhitvā mucyate bhayāt ||

devatā munayaḥ siddhāḥ pitaro manavo nṛpāḥ |
yacchanti kāmān gṛṇataḥ śṛṇvato yasya kīrtanāt ||
entries.literal_english: No commentary.
entries.source_note: Pinned source: vishvAsa/purANam_vaiShNavam @ 100560de6c9f68c2875097d40a2012a84c784179; exact source range preserved.

entries.sanskrit: ऋग्-आद्य् अधीत्य द्विजो मधु-कुल्यादि यद् अनुविन्दते, तत् फलम् एतां पठित्वानुविन्दत इति ॥६३॥
entries.main_sanskrit:
ऋचो यजूंषि सामानि द्विजोऽधीत्यानुविन्दते ।  
मधु-कुल्या घृत-कुल्याः पयः-कुल्याश् च तत् फलम् ॥
entries.transliteration:
ṛco yajūṃṣi sāmāni dvijo’dhītyānuvindate |
madhu-kulyā ghṛta-kulyāḥ payaḥ-kulyāś ca tat phalam ||
entries.literal_english: By studying this Bhāgavatam, a brāhmaṇa can enjoy the same rivers of honey, ghee and milk he enjoys by studying the hymns of the Ṛg, Yajur and Sāma Vedas.
entries.source_note: Pinned source: vishvAsa/purANam_vaiShNavam @ 100560de6c9f68c2875097d40a2012a84c784179; exact source range preserved.

entries.sanskrit: किं च, प्रोक्तम् इति ॥६४॥
entries.main_sanskrit:
पुराण-संहिताम् एताम् अधीत्य प्रयतो द्विजः ।  
प्रोक्तं भगवता यत् तु तत् पदं परमं व्रजेत् ॥
entries.transliteration:
purāṇa-saṃhitām etām adhītya prayato dvijaḥ |
proktaṃ bhagavatā yat tu tat padaṃ paramaṃ vrajet ||
entries.literal_english: A brāhmaṇa who diligently reads this essential compilation of all the Purāṇas will go to the supreme destination, which the Supreme Lord Himself has herein described.
entries.source_note: Pinned source: vishvAsa/purANam_vaiShNavam @ 100560de6c9f68c2875097d40a2012a84c784179; exact source range preserved.

entries.sanskrit: राजन्य उदधि-मेखलां पृथ्वीम् । सन्धिर् आर्षः । विप्रोऽधीत्येत्य् आदिकं तत्-तत्-कामाग्रह-पराणां प्रवर्तनार्थम् आपात-फलम् ॥६५॥
entries.main_sanskrit:
विप्रोऽधीत्याप्नुयात् प्रज्ञां राजन्योदधि-मेखलाम् ।  
वैश्यो निधि-पतित्वं च शूद्रः शुध्येत पातकात् ॥
entries.transliteration:
vipro’dhītyāpnuyāt prajñāṃ rājanyodadhi-mekhalām |
vaiśyo nidhi-patitvaṃ ca śūdraḥ śudhyeta pātakāt ||
entries.literal_english: A brāhmaṇa who studies the Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam achieves firm intelligence in devotional service, a king who studies it gains sovereignty over the earth, a vaiśya acquires great treasure and a śūdra is freed from sinful reactions.
entries.source_note: Pinned source: vishvAsa/purANam_vaiShNavam @ 100560de6c9f68c2875097d40a2012a84c784179; exact source range preserved.

entries.sanskrit: अस्य पुराणस्यैवं प्रभावातिर् एके कारणम् आह—कलि-मलानां संहतिं समूहं कालयति विनाशयतीति तथा । इतरत्र शास्त्रान्तरे ॥६६॥
entries.main_sanskrit:
कलि-मल-संहति-कालनोऽखिलेशो

हरिर् इतरत्र न गीयते ह्य् अभीक्ष्णम् ।

इह तु पुनर् भगवान् अशेष-मूर्तिः

परिपठितोऽनु-पदं कथा-प्रसङ्गैः ॥
entries.transliteration:
kali-mala-saṃhati-kālano’khileśo

harir itaratra na gīyate hy abhīkṣṇam |

iha tu punar bhagavān aśeṣa-mūrtiḥ

paripaṭhito’nu-padaṃ kathā-prasaṅgaiḥ ||
entries.literal_english: Lord Hari, the supreme controller of all beings, annihilates the accumulated sins of the Kali age, yet other literatures do not constantly glorify Him. But that Supreme Personality of Godhead, appearing in His innumerable personal expansions, is abundantly and constantly described throughout the various narrations of this Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam.
entries.source_note: Pinned source: vishvAsa/purANam_vaiShNavam @ 100560de6c9f68c2875097d40a2012a84c784179; exact source range preserved.

entries.sanskrit: शास्त्र-प्रतिपादितं भगवन्तं नमस्करोति—तम् इति द्वाभ्यम् । जगद्-उदय-स्थिति-संयमात्मानो रज-आदयः शक्तयो यस्य तम् । द्यु-पतिभिर् देवैर् अपि दुरवसितोऽज्ञातः स्तवः स्तोत्रं यस्य तम् ॥६७॥
entries.main_sanskrit:
तम् अहम् अजम् अनन्तम् आत्म-तत्त्वम् 

जगद्-उदय-स्थिति-संयमात्म-शक्तिम् ।

द्यु-पतिभिर् अज-शक्र-शङ्कराद्यैर्

दुरवसित-स्तवम् अच्युतं नतोऽस्मि ॥
entries.transliteration:
tam aham ajam anantam ātma-tattvam

jagad-udaya-sthiti-saṃyamātma-śaktim |

dyu-patibhir aja-śakra-śaṅkarādyair

duravasita-stavam acyutaṃ nato’smi ||
entries.literal_english: I bow down to that unborn and infinite Supreme Soul, whose personal energies effect the creation, maintenance and destruction of the material universe. Even Brahmā, Indra, Śaṅkara and the other lords of the heavenly planets cannot fathom the glories of that infallible Personality of Godhead.
entries.source_note: Pinned source: vishvAsa/purANam_vaiShNavam @ 100560de6c9f68c2875097d40a2012a84c784179; exact source range preserved.

entries.sanskrit: न व्याख्यातम्।
entries.main_sanskrit:
उपचित-नव-शक्तिभिः स्व आत्मन्य्

उपरचित-स्थिर-जङ्गमालयाय ।

भगवत उपलब्धि-मात्र-धाम्ने

सुर-ऋषभाय नमः सनातनाय ॥
entries.transliteration:
upacita-nava-śaktibhiḥ sva ātmany

uparacita-sthira-jaṅgamālayāya |

bhagavata upalabdhi-mātra-dhāmne

sura-ṛṣabhāya namaḥ sanātanāya ||
entries.literal_english: No commentary.
entries.source_note: Pinned source: vishvAsa/purANam_vaiShNavam @ 100560de6c9f68c2875097d40a2012a84c784179; exact source range preserved.

entries.sanskrit: श्री-गुरुं नमस्करोति । स्व-सुखेनैव निभृतं पूर्णं चेतो यस्य । तेनैव व्युदस्तोऽन्यस्मिन् भावो यस्य तथाभूतोऽप्य् अजितस्य रुचिराभिर् लीलाभिर् आकृष्टः सारः स्व-सुख-गतं स्थैर्यं यस्य सः । तत्त्व-दीपं परमार्थ-प्रकाशकं श्री-भागवतं यो व्यतनुत तं नतोऽस्मीति ॥६९॥
entries.main_sanskrit:
स्व-सुख-निभृत-चेतास् तद्-व्युदस्तान्य-भावोऽप्य् 

अजित-रुचिर-लीलाकृष्ट-सारस् तदीयम् ।

व्यतनुत कृपया यस् तत्त्व-दीपं पुराणं

तम् अखिल-वृजिन-घ्नं व्यास-सूनुं नतोऽस्मि ॥
entries.transliteration:
sva-sukha-nibhṛta-cetās tad-vyudastānya-bhāvo’py

ajita-rucira-līlākṛṣṭa-sāras tadīyam |

vyatanuta kṛpayā yas tattva-dīpaṃ purāṇaṃ

tam akhila-vṛjina-ghnaṃ vyāsa-sūnuṃ nato’smi ||
word_for_word: consisting of the activities of the Lord
entries.literal_english: Let me offer my respectful obeisances unto my spiritual master, the son of Vyāsadeva, Śukadeva Gosvāmī. It is he who defeats all inauspicious things within this universe. Although in the beginning he was absorbed in the happiness of Brahman realization and was living in a secluded place, giving up all other types of consciousness, he became attracted by the pleasing, most melodious pastimes of Lord Śrī Kṛṣṇa. He therefore mercifully spoke this supreme Purāṇa, Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam, which is the bright light of the Absolute Truth and which describes the activities of the Lord.
